preserved_initial_preflight.reason: Compared typed checkpoint serialization hash against V24 JSON-Value serialization hash. Corrected check uses the identical V24 before_audio representation and requires an exact hash before proceeding.

interpretation.verb: Heard verb changes action logits substantially, but EAT still outranks the legal Vocalize report at the held/GetFood witness. Its native imitation-component gradient is nonzero and lowers that incorrect margin under the existing action mask. No disconnected input or zero teaching gradient at this witness. Historical normalized batch and mixture gradients are not reproduced.
interpretation.speech: Missing speech targets give zero direct speech-head gradient. The real premature-event silence targets give 64 nonzero gate coordinates and lower first presence while raising stop. Untreated permits this signal in its retained stage mask; MixedGrounded4 freezes it out. No gate supervision or mask change is applied.
interpretation.limits: Only two post-hoc pre-sleep witnesses, previously trained language source and care mixture; no learned behavioral correction, new held-out competence, sleep-retention improvement, actual optimizer effect or new SLM contribution.

publication_scope: All 16 measured rows retain first-two raw speech outputs and relevant food Eat/Grab/Idle/Vocalize logits. Full native result, all candidate/six-step logits, tapes, gradients and private states remain unmodified locally and are hash-bound here; private checkpoints and executables are not published.
